page.layout: One column of verse, centred under the running head. A printed heading above a short passage sits in the middle of the column. Page number at top right. Gathering signature at the foot. Small reference marks stand in the right margin beside two lines. Pen underlining and an ink blot are not printed text.

p.i: Cum contra Gallos bellum Papa Iulius effet / Gesturus, sicut fama uetusta docet: / Ingentes Martis turmas contraxit & urbem / Egressus, saeuas edidit ore minas. / Iratusque sacras clauis in flumina iecit / Tibridis, hic urbi pons ubi iungit aquas. / Inde manu strictum uagina deripit ensem, / Exclamansque truci talia uoce refert: / Hic gladius Pauli nos nunc defendet ab hoste, / Quandoquidem clauis nil iuuat ista Petri,

main_text.head: Gaspari Bruschii locus de eodem Iulio.
main_text.p: Iulius aduersum Romae egressurus in hostem, / Magne sub imperio Maximiliane tuo: / Clauibus in Tiberim proiectis, ocyus ensem / Fulmineum arripiens, talia laetus ait: / Quandoquidem Petri nil nos iuuat aurea clauis, / Arma, arma & gladios experiamur eos, / Quos Paulus nostra Tarsensis in urbe reliquit: / Forsitan hi melius limina nostra tegent.

Sic nunc pontifices etiam magis arma requirunt, / Quàm clauis doceant ut Galilaee tuas. / At quanto melius facerent, & rectius ipsis / Consulerent sibi, consulerentq; suis: / Si veram fidei pietatem, & tam manifestam, / Haec spargi finerent dogmata vera Dei,

page.notes: Pen underlining under the two lines "Hic gladius Pauli" and "Quandoquidem clauis nil iuuat ista Petri" is handwriting and is not transcribed. Small reference marks ("<", "c") stand in the right margin beside "Quandoquidem Petri nil nos iuuat aurea clauis" and the next line; they are not legible as notes. An ink blot lies at the right edge and at the bottom right; the mark there is not printed text. Italic setting is read from the scan and may be only approximate for some lines. "Haec sparg[i] finerent" is partly obscured by a blot near "tam", so the words "tam" and "sparg" are doubtful. Verse is set in long lines; stanza breaks are taken from visible line groupings.
